name: Sign in and reach the SpendWise dashboard
description: Verifies the new opening flow leads through local name and mobile OTP verification into the app.
steps: Enter the displayed 6-digit demo verification code
expected: The sign-in flow completes and the SpendWise main website is visible with the signed-in user's name.

name: Analyze sample data after sign-in
description: Verifies the primary analysis experience still populates the dashboard after authentication.
setup: Sign in as Riddhima with a valid 10-digit mobile number using the displayed demo verification code
steps: Review the Overview and Insights sections
expected: Calculated totals, transaction count, top category, category chart, spending patterns, and smart insights are visible.

name: Add, edit, delete, and persist a manual expense
setup: Sign in as Riddhima and load sample data
description: Verifies transaction management remains durable after the new sign-in layer.
steps: Add an expense named "Library print" for ₹50
expected: The expense can be created and edited, disappears after confirmed deletion, and remains absent after refresh.

name: Use search and category filtering on mobile
setup: Sign in as Riddhima and load sample data
description: Verifies transaction discovery controls remain usable on a small screen.
expected: Only matching Transport transactions remain visible and the table controls remain usable on mobile.

name: Set a budget and export expense data
setup: Sign in as Riddhima and load sample data
description: Verifies core budgeting and export actions remain available after authentication.
steps: Review the budget percentage and status
expected: The budget card shows calculated usage and status, and an expense CSV download is initiated.
